votes.evidence_summary: HTTP 200 responses showing API correctly accepting valid passwords (8-char and complex) and rejecting short password
votes.rationale: Log shows API properly validating passwords: 8-char password 'abcdefgh' accepted, 9-char complex password 'ValidP@ss1' accepted, 1-char password 'a' rejected with code 1100; API behavior is correct per its actual constraint (6-72 chars per error message), this is a documentation mismatch issue not an API defect
